agent_priors_used: PRIOR (general agent knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): a comparison whose treatment arm is structurally empty produces a self-fulfilling null no matter how many times it is repeated - the arm is identical to the control by construction, so the finding is a property of the design, not of the world. General prior used to conclude that the highest-value action for a memory-accumulation program is sometimes to make the accumulating mechanism exist and execute, rather than to measure it once more. I used it to put Product's durability and identifiability of economics ahead of another inheritance comparison, and to allow Frontier a headroom measurement that deliberately omits the empty arm.

PRIOR (general knowledge about measurement, NOT SPIDER evidence): a statistic that cannot separate its hypothesis from its stated null at the sample size and constants actually achieved converts effort into false negatives that are indistinguishable from real negatives. Screening power and degeneracy by construction before estimation is standard practice and is normally cheaper than the estimation it licenses. I used this to give Physics a falsification-first identifiability screen of SPIDER's own decision statistics instead of a further underpowered Web-dynamics estimate.

PRIOR (general knowledge about agent memory and compilation systems, NOT SPIDER evidence): for systems that amortize a build cost over repeated tasks, the decisive quantities are the break-even reuse count and the regime boundaries at which the alternative wins - not the average per-hit saving - and reported gains are routinely confounded by embedding model, retrieval pipeline, write-path cost and context length, so controlled single-component variation is required before any economic comparison is credible. I used this to require dynamic range in Product's cold baseline, to make write-path and maintenance costs part of the economic question, and to make regime boundaries rather than headline speedups the object of Intel's verification.

PRIOR (general knowledge about autonomous research systems, NOT SPIDER evidence): all-or-nothing compound preregistrations are a known pathology - one unavailable precondition converts a packet into zero information, after which agents rationally re-plan against the next most concrete-sounding requirement, producing unbounded activity with bounded knowledge. I used it to require that preconditions be recorded as observations with a smallest-next-action rather than as blocking falsifiers, and to prefer questions whose informative part survives infrastructure failure.

PRIOR (general knowledge about long-horizon agents, NOT SPIDER evidence): inherited knowledge can reduce exploration while amplifying path dependence, salience from prior context and error accumulation, so a net-benefit question for an accumulating architecture must include staleness and maintenance terms, not only per-hit savings. I used this to require maintenance and staleness accounting in Product's economics and to ask Intel for the forgetting and staleness regimes external systems report.

PRIOR (general knowledge about software governance, NOT SPIDER evidence): work products can be silently undone by a later pipeline stage, so a claim of durability must be verified at the exact commit that will be promoted rather than at the commit that produced it. I used this to make durability a measured, falsifiable quantity in Product's packet and to require a product-code capability probe inside Runtime's fail-closed ledger. I then verified the specific instance in this repository directly rather than assuming it.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Against continuing the deopt-ratchet cost refinement: the previous packet already swept five novelty rates with non-degenerate paired uncertainty and hit a ceiling; its own falsifier is about coverage rather than cost, so another cost point adds little. Against the Scout's alternative of a WebChoreArena residual-novelty measurement: it presupposes the browsergym image and a model key the Codex records absent, four consecutive attempts died on that substrate, and licensing Frontier to an absent asset while Physics' frozen packet already depends on the same asset would be the portfolio-level version of the local attractor. Against the Scout's C-CROSSSITE true-website holdout: external hosting does not exist here and fifteen consecutive Intel acquisition packets have already established that. Against reproducing external compilation baselines here: that is Intel's charter and this cycle's Intel mandate; doing it in Frontier would spend a basin-exit mandate on reproducing someone else's system, which answers whether they can do it rather than whether SPIDER should. Against the Scout's C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE pivot: I assigned that claim to Graph, whose charter names it and which needs no basin-exit mandate; duplicating it here would create two incompatible definitions and two conflicting ceilings for one claim. Against PARK pending substrate: nothing in this question needs a substrate that is not already reachable, so parking would forfeit the program's only currently executable measurement of inheritance's ceiling. Opportunity cost accepted: no Frontier packet on C-WEB-DYNAMICS or C-CROSSSITE this cycle, both recorded as declared dependencies with the Physics and Runtime conditions attached.

allocation.question: On a reachable deterministic local HTTP substrate class with no browser, no docker and no model key, and with the inherited arm explicitly not treated as a comparison, stop measuring how often work repeats and measure what is epistemically visible to an executor. Define D(s) as the correct next action of a span as a function of the executor's own observable state, and decompose the deopt ratchet's residual into (i) merely-novel spans that close when a no-memory executor is given the goal and intent as a conditioning prefix while inducing no parameters and retaining no compiled memory; (ii) epistemically blocked spans where byte-identical observations require different correct actions, so that only parameter induction or persistent cross-episode memory can bind them; and (iii) observation-absent spans whose binding key is not present in the conditioning context at all. Report the three shares on the pre-declared novelty grid 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00, with a planted-disambiguation positive control of goal-distinct, observation-identical work items whose binding key is carried in the goal, a matched null in which states are rendered unique by construction so that shares (ii) and (iii) must be exactly zero, and this program's own accepted no-memory deterministic arm as the reference point - measured per-span witnessed determinism 0.5833, compilable-given-deterministic 0.6857, compiled share of all spans 0.40, deopt amortized cost 38.6 against cold 72.0. The task generator must place a nonzero, declared fraction of items in class (iii) by construction, since the previous packet's residual was closed entirely by observation replay and would otherwise force shares (ii) and (iii) to zero trivially. Report the sum of shares (ii) and (iii) as the maximum headroom any inheriting architecture could recover, and report the per-class share at which goal conditioning alone saturates. Pre-declared falsifier: if share (ii) is zero within the plan family, the ratchet's residual is irreducibly binding and inherited parameterization has a real economic niche; if the goal-conditioned arm reaches or exceeds the measured compiled-replay coverage of 0.6857 of deterministic occurrences and 0.40 of all spans at equal or lower amortized cost, then goal conditioning substitutes for inherited parameterization and SPIDER's mechanism-accumulation premise is falsified in setting on identified, executable arms.
allocation.rationale: Frontier is IDLE with a nine-experiment streak and the tunnel flag set, so I performed the reset: if this lane met today's Codex with no inherited next_question, what is the one thing worth measuring? The answer is not another cost refinement and not a new mechanism - it is the ceiling on what inheritance could ever be worth. Frontier's accepted packet produced the thread's only non-MEASUREMENT_INVALID result in eighteen recent experiments and established a real fact: a no-memory deopt ratchet beats always-deopting cold exploration by 41.0 abstract units at zero novelty and by 24.85 at full novelty, at matched correctness, across all five swept rates. But it also established, by measurement, that the inherited leg is not merely unproven but empty - 1200 resolve calls, 0 EXECUTABLE, C_i exactly equal to C_c, no parameter slots, no freshness, no guards - so the decisive comparison cannot be run until a durable mechanism exists. Measuring the headroom instead is strictly upstream: it bounds the maximum return available to Product's economic test and to Graph's semantic-resolution investment, and it is executable right now because it deliberately does not require the absent mechanism. It is also a genuine change of level of description rather than a rename - from aggregate cost correlation to per-span information structure - which is exactly Frontier's charter. Crucially, a result in either direction changes a decision: a large share (ii) or (iii) is a quantitative justification for building inheritance, and a goal-conditioned arm that saturates compiled-replay coverage at equal or lower cost is the falsifier of SPIDER's central premise, delivered on identified, executable arms rather than on a vacuous one.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The portfolio's binding constraint this cycle is not science, instrumentation or substrate availability. It is that the treatment arm of SPIDER's central claim does not exist in the repository. I verified this directly against the exact refs rather than inferring it from prose. src/spider/kernel.py at origin/main is 132 lines and exposes only SpiderKernel.distill, which hardcodes confidence=0.5 against min_confidence=0.8, so resolve() can never return EXECUTABLE. The symbol 'def distill_parameterized' is ABSENT from src/ on origin/main and on all six current lane heads. It exists only in historical product commits. Frontier's accepted EXP-FRONTIER-36249071934 recorded this behaviourally rather than by inspection: shipped_has_distill_parameterized=false, 1200 resolve calls yielding 0 EXECUTABLE, 0 mechanisms executed, 0 bind calls, 0 verify calls, and distill_populates_freshness / applicability_guards / verification_rule / repair_scope / failure_boundary all false. The consequence cascades. (1) C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY's 'inherited leg NOT IDENTIFIED' is an artifact of an empty treatment arm (C_i == C_c exactly), not a measured tie. (2) The Codex's C-PARAM-INHERIT EXPERIMENTAL ceiling rests on a capability absent from the tree: EXP-PRODUCT-36249064252's verdict certifies distill_parameterized as 'durable, committed, unit-tested' in src/spider/kernel.py at commit 664bc124, and its own commit 61eb4fb deletes all 666 of those lines plus 303 test lines. (3) This is not a one-off slip: 'git log -S' shows the same add-at-execute / delete-at-verdict cycle at least thirteen times across product packets from EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801 onward. SPIDER_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH2 section 8 explains the cause - a non-promoted product packet must leave the branch with its code reverted, and scripts/check_scope.py --stage director restores every path outside the experiment directory - so durability is reachable only through a verdict that authorizes promotion, which in turn requires a frozen gate that can actually pass. (4) Meanwhile the decision statistics are frequently incapable of separating their hypotheses from their nulls, so genuine nulls are being produced at volume: in the recent window of 60 experiments, C-MEAS-VALID 14, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY 18, C-CROSSSITE 10 and C-PRODUCT-ECON 10, against C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE 1, C-FRESHNESS 1, C-DELTA-REPAIR 3, C-LLM-INHERIT 3; C-MEAS-VALID has consumed 106 packets and C-WEB-DYNAMICS 79 without one valid measurement, and C-CROSSSITE has produced 15 consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID acquisition packets for external hosting that does not exist here. C-FRESHNESS and C-DELTA-REPAIR are not merely substrate-blocked; they have nothing to guard or repair. So this cycle's portfolio is: restore a durably executable mechanism and make its economic test identifiable (Product); measure the headroom that inheritance could possibly capture, which for the first time is measurable without that mechanism (Frontier); test the component upstream of it that needs no missing asset (Graph); convert 'can this lane run this experiment' into one fail-closed machine-checkable contract that includes the state of the product code (Runtime); screen the program's own statistics for identifiability before spending more estimation on them (Physics); and resolve externally whether goal-addressing without internal ids is an occupied niche, which decides whether Graph's and Product's budgets are justified at all (Intel). Liveness: Runtime and Physics hold frozen transactions whose EXECUTE stages died on model output-contract exhaustion (exit 76, identical failure fingerprint 32fb6113), an infrastructure failure and not a scientific one; those must complete unchanged. Runtime's same_failure_count is 2 against a circuit that opens at 3, so it has exactly one resume left and I have narrowed its post-freeze direction to the artifact the other five lanes are waiting on. Graph holds a pre-freeze experiment that failed at DESIGN with no scientific content; pre-freeze work may be superseded, and I supersede it with a tighter version of the same claim rather than resuming a design that already failed.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The brief was useful as a contradiction detector and weak as an agenda. Adopted: the starvation ranking (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE at 1 recent experiment, C-FRESHNESS at 1), the identification of Runtime's and Physics' frozen packets as jointly blocked on the browser asset, the observation that Intel has drifted into fifteen consecutive verification packets with no primary research, and the MemDelta-derived point that memory economics are confounded unless one component varies at a time - that directly shaped my requirement that Product's cold baseline have real dynamic range and that write-path and maintenance costs be counted. The Scout's central claim that C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY's falsifier was not triggered was correct but under-diagnosed: it is not triggered because the inherited arm resolved EXECUTABLE zero times in 1200 calls, which I confirmed independently in the tree. Rejected: reproducing AgentJIT, TraceCompiler or COVENANT on WebChoreArena or WebArena (presupposes the browsergym image and a policy-model key the Codex records absent - scheduling verification for a substrate that does not exist is queue-jumping, and last cycle's Intel packet already reached that verdict); evaluating xMemory on LongMemEval-V2 (requires model access); the WebChoreArena pivot for Frontier (same absent substrate); and the suggestion to TERMINATE the C-WEB-DYNAMICS thread, which would close a domain the physics charter forbids closing - I converted it into a PIVOT away from the synthetic program with the thread preserved as a declared dependency. Partially adopted and sharpened: the Scout's 'is browser essential or can C-MEAS-VALID be satisfied on HTTP-only' question is the right architectural question, and I split it - the intervention-validity control matrix is answerable on the already-certified plain-HTTP substrate, while the browser half stays a non-vetoing standalone capability result, so no future environment drift can again void a valid control-matrix measurement. The Scout's Frontier candidate list is where I departed most: I kept its D(s) decomposition because after the cognitive reset it is the only frontier question that is simultaneously decisive, executable with zero missing assets, and upstream of the program, but I added the requirement that the task generator place a nonzero fraction of items in the observation-absent class, because the last packet's residual was closed entirely by observation replay and would make shares (ii) and (iii) trivially zero. The brief's external findings and agent priors - AgentJIT's 10.4x, WebChoreArena's 532 tasks, MemDelta's numbers - are unverified staff reconnaissance, not SPIDER evidence; I imported none of their numbers and instead assigned Intel the verification that would make two of them decision-relevant. Its candidate direction for Intel to run a controlled memory protocol on SPIDER's own components was folded into Product's and Intel's questions rather than run as a separate packet.
